# Cooking

Curated by Skill Harbor — a fundamentals-first cooking skill: pinch-grip knife work and safe dicing/mincing technique, sauce building from a proper roux (white, blond, dark) through pan sauces, and bread baking basics — grounded in professional references (The Professional Chef 10th ed., Jacques Pépin's New Complete Techniques, Tartine Bread). It ships with reference files (e.g. a mother-sauce tree) and names its prerequisites honestly (sharp knife, scale, instant-read thermometer).
